pages.title: How to read the evidence synthesis
text: **Evidence supports a particular proposition under particular conditions**

This synthesis evaluates the scientific basis and unresolved questions behind the proposed platform. It is a focused critical review, not a systematic review with exhaustive database coverage or a meta-analysis. Original studies, standards, agency guidance and manufacturer documentation serve different purposes and should not be treated as interchangeable levels of proof.
## Four questions for each source

The relevant questions are what was measured, in which population, against which comparator and under which operating conditions. A result can be credible within its study while remaining insufficient for a different specimen, organism, instrument or clinical decision. Publication establishes an accessible account of work; it does not independently certify every claim in that account.
## Reading quantitative results

Agreement, precision, accuracy, sensitivity and time to result answer different questions. A high correlation can coexist with systematic measurement bias. A small average error can conceal clinically important outliers. A rapid answer among selected successful runs can coexist with a substantial unresolved fraction.

Where the available evidence does not establish a denominator, independent validation or local applicability, the conclusion remains bounded. The practical outcome of this review is a set of testable design decisions and research questions. No external study is represented as an AMReye.AI experiment, and no aggregate performance score is assigned to the proposed platform.

pages.title: Disk diffusion standards and reader evidence
text: **A calibrated image does not replace the biological method**

CLSI M100 Edition 36 and EUCAST clinical breakpoint tables version 16.1 were the current editions verified for this publication date. Their applicability depends on the relevant method, organism, antimicrobial and conditions. A breakpoint value detached from those conditions is not a complete interpretation rule. [R01] [R02]

The CLSI correction of 9 July 2026 restores the sulfamethoxazole concentrations in combination MIC notation in Table 2H-1. It illustrates why an edition number alone is insufficient version control. The correction does not create a disk-diffusion indication where the table's method restrictions do not permit one. [R74]
## Reader precision is one component

Hombach and colleagues' variance analysis distinguished biological variation from technical contributions, including preparation, streaking, materials and reading. Their estimated contributions varied substantially across the tested organism–drug combinations. The findings support evaluating the entire preparation-to-reading process rather than assuming that image precision determines total assay precision. [R67]
## Consequence for development

Reader V1 should preserve the distinction between measurement uncertainty and method variability. Its interface should expose missing method context before category assignment. Validation should include plates near relevant decision boundaries and difficult reading conditions, with a predefined route for unresolved cases. Greater numerical precision should never be presented as proof that an unsuitable biological preparation has become valid.

pages.title: External evidence on automated zone measurement
text: **Automated measurement evidence must disclose human intervention**

Hombach et al. compared on-screen adjusted Sirscan readings with manual measurements and separately assessed repeated automated readings. The study reported improved repeatability in the automated condition. The distinction between adjusted clinical readings and the precision experiment matters: their results do not establish that every autonomous reading was correct without review. [R66]
## A recent AI study requires additional clarification

The 2026 study by Ciftci and colleagues reports categorical agreement of 94.2% and mean absolute diameter error of 0.42 mm. Its methods describe 207 original photographs in one passage and 1,024 baseline images elsewhere, expanded to 5,120. The detection metric also differs between a table and the ablation narrative. These counts and the independence of plate/isolate partitions require clarification before the headline metrics can serve as a robust benchmark. [R12]
## Proposed evaluation response

AMReye.AI should report the unedited model output and the final reviewed result separately. Every evaluated plate should retain its split assignment, source image lineage and correction history. An augmented image must remain in the same partition as its source and associated biological unit.

Evidence should make these distinctions auditable. A model explanation or attention map can support investigation, but it cannot substitute for independent performance evaluation or establish that a model has learned a biologically valid mechanism.

pages.title: External evidence on rapid single cell AST
text: **Rapid single-cell AST demonstrates a route, not a universal timescale**

Baltekin et al. demonstrated direct single-cell imaging in a microfluidic setting and reported susceptibility classification for 49 clinical uropathogenic E. coli isolates against ciprofloxacin within ten minutes of the measurement sequence. The overall method was described as requiring less than thirty minutes from sample loading. The narrow organism–drug evaluation and the timing origin are essential parts of that result. [R11]
## Translation questions for AMReye.AI

The study motivates investigation of early phenotypic responses where sufficient cells can be observed under a controlled antimicrobial exposure. It does not demonstrate that an ordinary endpoint plate photograph can deliver the same answer. Differences in specimen preparation, cell capture, exposure, optical sampling and decision criteria must be evaluated explicitly.
## Sub-two-hour research target

The proposed target should begin with a defined specimen and clock origin, not a platform-wide promise. A feasibility study should prespecify the proportion of eligible samples expected to receive a reportable answer, the comparator method and acceptable uncertainty. Time distributions should include failed runs and repeats.

A useful early answer is one whose correctness and limits are understood. If a sample requires longer observation, abstention preserves the distinction between a target and an established capability. Faster inference cannot compensate for insufficient biological information.

pages.title: External evidence on heteroresistance in infection
text: **Heteroresistance has mechanistic and context-dependent clinical evidence**

Band et al. linked an initially susceptible classification of Enterobacter cloacae with a resistant subpopulation and treatment failure in a murine infection model. This establishes a biologically consequential example under the tested conditions, rather than a universal human outcome or an imaging diagnostic rule. [R08]

Doijad and colleagues examined mechanistic determinants of colistin heteroresistance in the Enterobacter cloacae complex. Kupke and colleagues later described transient amplification events in a veterinary clinical isolate. Together these studies motivate attention to population structure and unstable resistance phenotypes without implying a single mechanism for all organisms and drugs. [R09] [R60]
## Clinical association is not uniform

Wei et al. identified heteroresistance in 40 of 164 non-resistant isolates within a 212-isolate collection. The study did not find a significant increase in the assessed hospitalization or progression outcomes. Its retrospective context and denominators should accompany interpretation. This finding does not negate the murine mechanism; it limits a universal clinical-outcome inference. [R61]
## Proposed contribution of imaging

AMReye.AI can investigate whether longitudinal spatial observations improve recognition of candidate minority growth. The first validation question is detection of a reproducible visual event. Confirmation of heteroresistance is a separate biological question requiring appropriate reference characterization.
The product should preserve the chain between these stages. It should not label every satellite colony as resistant or infer clinical treatment failure from an image alone.

pages.title: External evidence on heteroresistance and combinations
text: **Combination findings generate hypotheses that require their own evaluation**

Band et al.'s 2019 work investigated the exploitation of heteroresistance to identify effective antibiotic combinations. The study provides a mechanistic reason to examine how differently susceptible subpopulations respond to combined exposures. It does not authorize a general combination recommendation or establish a treatment-selection function for AMReye.AI. [R07]
## A proposed research use

The platform could support controlled experiments by recording spatial growth, exposure context and time-dependent responses under a prespecified design. Its contribution would be measurement and traceability. Interpretation of interaction, mechanism and therapeutic significance would require the appropriate experimental and clinical expertise.
## Avoid a false shortcut from image to therapy

An apparent reduction in visible growth can result from different biological processes. A single image cannot establish killing, durable suppression, mechanism or patient benefit. Even a reproducible laboratory interaction remains conditional on the tested system.

The proposed software should therefore present research measurements and uncertainty without generating autonomous treatment instructions. A useful capability would be the ability to compare hypotheses and retrieve the complete experimental record. The development objective is to make combination research more inspectable, while keeping therapeutic claims behind their own evidence and authorization requirements.

pages.title: Definitions of persistence and tolerance
text: **Resistance, tolerance and persistence describe different response patterns**

The consensus statement by Balaban and colleagues distinguishes resistance, which concerns growth under antimicrobial exposure, from tolerance and persistence, which concern survival during killing. Persistence refers to a surviving subpopulation rather than uniformly slower killing across the population. These distinctions require suitable experimental endpoints and cannot be established by vocabulary alone. [R10]
## Implication for a measurement platform

An endpoint zone image primarily records spatial growth inhibition under its method conditions. A time series may reveal additional dynamics, but the observable signal still has to match the biological question. An unchanged object might be alive, dead or an imaging artifact. Absence of visible expansion does not establish eradication.
## Design the record around the actual endpoint

The proposed data model should store whether an experiment measures growth, viable survival, metabolic response or another signal. Analysis should preserve the observation period and exposure definition. A generic field called “resistance score” would obscure distinctions that matter scientifically.

For research comparisons, the programme should agree on terminology before data collection. Reviewers should be able to identify whether a claim follows from the measured endpoint or remains a hypothesis. This is especially relevant when multimodal measurements disagree: a metabolic signal and an optical growth signal may answer different questions rather than indicate that one sensor has failed. Biological interpretation should precede automatic reconciliation.

pages.title: Evidence for spatial and temporal growth models
text: **Growth models explain variation without guaranteeing an individual future**

Thomas et al. developed a stochastic cellular model linking gene expression, metabolism and replication. The work connects fluctuations in cellular processes with heterogeneous growth and evaluates model behavior against reported physiological observations. It provides a basis for investigating variable responses, not a validated forecasting model for a particular AMReye.AI plate. [R13]

Kapteyn, Pretorius and Willcox describe probabilistic graphical modelling for digital twins in an engineering setting. Its relevance here is methodological: distinguish latent state, observation, uncertainty and decision. Biological calibration and validation remain separate work. [R59]
## Evidence needed at plate scale

The proposed twin must connect its latent variables to actual measurable quantities. A plausible growth equation is insufficient if several parameter combinations fit the same short observation period but predict incompatible futures. That situation is an identifiability limitation, not a reason to select the most visually convincing trajectory.
## Scientific consequence

Simulation continuity preserves computation after physical observation ends. It cannot preserve knowledge of unobserved contamination, environmental changes or new biological events. The proposed publication and interface should retain the final measured state and show how uncertainty evolves beyond it. Model-based exploration remains valuable precisely when its assumptions and limits can be inspected.

pages.title: Optical metrology evidence
text: **Sensor specifications and system metrology answer different questions**

EMVA 1288 provides a framework for characterizing camera behavior. Optical documentation explains how geometry, perspective and lens choice affect imaging. The JCGM uncertainty framework supports an explicit account of contributions to a measurement result. None supplies an automatic accuracy specification for an assembled plate reader. [R14] [R15] [R16]
## The measurement chain is the object of validation

A camera can have a small pixel pitch while the final system has substantial error from distortion, defocus, plate height, reflections or boundary interpretation. Similarly, a lens chosen for reduced perspective sensitivity still requires alignment and verification across the actual object field.
## Proposed metrology experiment

The optical bench should compare known geometric targets at multiple positions and relevant heights. Repeat captures should vary remounting, illumination and qualified environmental conditions. The analysis should separate scale error, spatial distortion and repeatability, then examine biological boundaries using independent reference readings.

The resulting evidence should state where measurements are eligible and when recalibration or rejection is necessary. Object sampling in micrometres per pixel is a useful design calculation, but it should be reported separately from diameter uncertainty in millimetres. Keeping those quantities distinct prevents a component specification from becoming an unsupported biological measurement claim.

pages.title: Gas and environmental sensor evidence
text: **Environmental sensing supports context before it supports biological inference**

Manufacturer documentation for gas and environmental sensors establishes their physical signals, operating ranges and integration requirements. A broad gas response or a temperature channel does not identify a bacterial species, resistance mechanism or metabolite without additional evidence. The platform's candidate catalogue therefore separates environmental monitoring from exploratory biological sensing. [R17] [R18]
## A controlled question for each signal

Temperature, humidity and gas measurements can help explain whether acquisition occurred under qualified conditions. Using the same channels as biological predictors is a separate research programme. It requires demonstrating that the signal reflects the intended biology rather than media, cleaning agents, room conditions or sensor history.
## Evidence threshold for inclusion

A channel should earn its place through incremental information, reliability or control value. A modality that improves apparent training accuracy but fails across sites should not be described as robust biological sensing. Candidate selection should compare its benefit with the added calibration, maintenance and contamination-control burden.

The strongest near-term use may be detecting a condition that makes the optical result unreliable. That is a meaningful contribution even when the channel cannot support a standalone diagnostic inference. The product should express this role directly, rather than convert every installed sensor into a separate clinical claim.
